meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加本地 Ollama 服务，容器代理可直接调用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的容器代理需要调用本地 Ollama 模型，又不想手动折腾配置
copy.tagline_en: Connect your container agent to local Ollama models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your container agent needs to call local Ollama models and you'd prefer a straightforward setup

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 可通过 MCP 工具调用本机 Ollama 的模型:列出已装模型、向指定模型发送提示词;若开启管理开关,还能拉取、删除模型、查看模型信息和内存中运行状态。
howto.when: 当用户要求为项目接入 Ollama 本地模型、让容器里的代理使用 Ollama,或提到 Ollama 集成时触发。

say.text: 用 ollama 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: Claude 会先列出模型再生成回答。

say.text: 把 gemma3:1b 模型拉下来
say.note: 需在 .env 开启管理工具才会执行。

say.text: 现在内存里加载了哪些 ollama 模型?
say.note: 需开启管理工具才会列出。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use local Ollama models through MCP tools: list installed models and send prompts to a specified model. If the admin flag is enabled, it can also pull/delete models, show model details, and list models loaded in memory.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to integrate Ollama into the project, have the container agent use local models, or mentions adding the Ollama MCP server.

say_en.text: Use ollama to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Claude will list models first, then generate an answer.
Requires the admin tools flag enabled in .env.

say_en.text: Which ollama models are currently loaded in memory?
say_en.note: Requires the admin tools flag to be enabled.
